name: Yogurt
tagline: MIT desktop app from Frigade for private AI meeting notes on Mac, Windows and Linux: records calls locally with no bot joining the meeting, transcribes with Whisper and summarizes with a local llama.cpp model into next steps by person, and ships an MCP server

xSignals.text:
This app writes your meeting notes without a bot joining the call!

Yogurt records your calls on your own machine, so no bot shows up in the meeting.

It can replace a paid meeting-notes subscription like Granola, and your notes stay with you.
